global: This is a wireframe specimen. All schema notes are advisory for the production implementation. No JSON-LD is emitted here.

sections.intake-search: Search form would benefit from schema.org/WebPage + potential SearchAction. In production the form action would be a real GET or progressive enhancement to SPA search.
sections.results-grid: Use ItemList containing multiple Hotel + Offer. AggregateRating per hotel. ImageObject for thumbnails.
sections.detail-selection: Primary LodgingBusiness + Hotel + individual Offer for each room type. BreadcrumbList. Review markup if reviews surface is added.
sections.checkout-preview: Reservation + potential Order status. Do not mark up as confirmed until real backend returns reservationId.

notes: Future handoff export will turn these into concrete schema requirements for the prod team.
